title: Pita Maata Santan
desc: Shikha and Pradeep's marital bliss is shattered when he takes their daughter, Jaya, away. A few years later, fate brings them face to face when Jaya becomes employed in Shikha's company.

title: Ogo Bodhu Shundori
desc: Tensions rise between a married couple with conflicting personalities as the husband offers shelter to a woman in their home.

title: Tomai Pabo Bole
desc: Two neighbouring families are embroiled in a bitter rivalry. However, in an interesting turn of events, the son of one family falls in love with the daughter of the other.

title: 100 Percent Love
desc: Competitive peers Balu and Mahalakshmi have ego clashes while in college. When they meet again after a few years, they try to outdo each other until they realise that they are in love.
